'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 European heatwaves]]
**[[Romania]] begins shutting down the second [[Nuclear reactor|reactor]] at the [[Cernavodă Nuclear Power Plant]], the country's only [[Nuclear power in Romania|nuclear power]] plant, after a drought lowered the [[Danube]] river below the level required for [[Nuclear reactor coolant|cooling]], leaving both reactors offline. [[Bolojan cabinet|The government]] says alternative sources and imports will cover [[Electricity sector in Romania|electricity demand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/romania-europe-drought-energy-weather-4239b119af1153fc0a57093b04df555b (AP)]
*[[Greece]]'s [[National Public Health Organization (Greece)|public health agency]] reports 110 [[West Nile virus]] infections and nine deaths in 2026, including 45 new cases in one week, as authorities increase [[mosquito control|mosquito control]] measures in the [[Athens metropolitan area]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/greece-reports-significant-rise-in-west-nile-virus-cases-with-9-dead (AFP via ''Daily Sabah'')]
